extracted_information: The EcoScan CZ project is an MVP web application built with Rust (backend microservices) and React TypeScript (frontend admin dashboard). It aims to monitor the fullness of city trash bins. Administrators can generate QR codes for specific bin locations, and citizens can report the status of a bin by scanning the QR code. The backend utilizes AWS Lambda for microservices and DynamoDB for data storage. The infrastructure is defined using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
features: Monitoring the fullness of city trash bins
Administrators can generate QR codes for specific trash bin locations
Citizens can report bin status via QR code scan
Automated push/email notifications when a bin is full (notifier service)
Authenticated admin interface for bin/location management
Running average calculation for bin status based on reports
